$comment: The SPDX licence allow-list for entry-core.v1.schema.json's `license` field (internal project documentation Section 3.6). scripts/validate.ts MUST reject a submission whose `license` is neither the literal string "other" nor an `id` present here. This is a starting curated set, not an exhaustive SPDX mirror: extend it by adding an entry, never by relaxing the check to accept an arbitrary SPDX identifier unchecked. An entry whose licence is not on this list MUST use `license: "other"` plus a required `license_url`, so it is still discoverable and its licence is still honestly stated, just not machine-verified against SPDX.
